to.n: the session remount (profile-starvation fifth face) > HOST GLUE: an ownership change rides the host's OWN admission feed and heals a registered space server's foreign session — nothing hand-fed

from.n: the session remount (profile-starvation fifth face) > lands a read that was in flight when the genesis ACL revoked its session

to.n: the session remount (profile-starvation fifth face) > lands a read that was in flight when an ownership change revoked its session

from.n: the session remount (profile-starvation fifth face) > lands every read that joined a fetch in flight when the genesis ACL revoked its session
